papers.title_en: Deep Reinforcement Learning-Based Energy Management for Hydrogen-Enabled Community Microgrids Under Uncertainty
papers.authors: Mohamed Atef, Sanath Alahakoon, Umme Mumtahina, Peter Wolfs, Tamer Khatib, Moslem Uddin
papers.evidence: 开发基于PPO的氢能-电池微电网能量管理，涉及RL方法和混合能源管理
papers.tldr: 针对氢能社区微电网中光伏、风电和负荷不确定性及电池-氢储能耦合难题，提出基于近端策略优化（PPO）的连续动作能量管理方法。在澳大利亚罗克汉普顿1000户社区8760小时年运行中，策略实现A$195,690年净收入、91.2%可再生占比、0.085 kg CO2/kWh碳强度及99.8%负荷满足率；电网故障概率从1%升至5%时，电池放电与柴油发电增加逾4倍，仍维持98.8%供电可靠率。结果证明PPO能有效协调电池-氢能调度，提升经济性与韧性，并强调了可再生剖面变异性和评估边界的影响。
papers.abstract_en: Hydrogen-enabled community microgrids can improve renewable energy utilization and local resilience, but their operation is complicated by intermittent generation, uncertain residential demand, dynamic electricity prices, and the coupled dynamics of battery and hydrogen storage. This paper develops a proximal policy optimization (PPO)-based energy management system (EMS) for a grid-connected community microgrid integrating photovoltaic and wind generation, battery storage, an electrolyzer, hydrogen storage, a fuel cell, and diesel backup. The EMS is formulated as a Markov decision process with an 11-dimensional state and three continuous control actions for battery, diesel, and hydrogen dispatch; grid exchange is determined from the residual power balance. The framework is evaluated using 8,760 hourly observations for a 1,000-household community in Rockhampton, Australia. Under the normal operating scenario, the learned policy produced a net annual operating revenue of A$195,690.67, a renewable fraction of 91.2%, a carbon intensity of 0.085 kg CO2/kWh under the adopted accounting boundary, and 99.77% load satisfaction. With the hourly grid-outage probability increased from 1% to 5%, the policy retained A$169,892.21 in net operating revenue and supplied 98.79% of demand, supported by a 413% increase in battery discharge and a 429% increase in diesel generation. The results demonstrate the potential of PPO for coordinated battery-hydrogen dispatch while also highlighting sensitivity to renewable-profile variability, training stability, and the choice of evaluation boundary.

papers.title_en: Deep Reinforcement Learning-Based Energy Management for Hydrogen-Enabled Community Microgrids Under Uncertainty
papers.authors: Mohamed Atef, Sanath Alahakoon, Umme Mumtahina, Peter Wolfs, Tamer Khatib, Moslem Uddin
papers.evidence: 基于强化学习的燃料电池/电池微电网能量管理
papers.tldr: 氢能社区微电网运行中存在光伏风电间歇、负荷随机和电池-氢储耦合等不确定因素。本文提出基于PPO的强化学习能源管理，以11维状态驱动电池、柴油和氢能三者协同调度。在罗克汉普顿1000户社区实测8760小时数据上，正常场景获净收入19.57万澳元、可再生占比91.2%、碳强度0.085 kg CO2/kWh；故障率升至5%时，电池放电增4.1倍、柴油增4.3倍，仍保持98.8%供电。验证了深度强化学习协调氢-电储能的潜力，也揭示出对训练稳定性及评估边界的敏感性。
